zh: 位置 p 被区间 [l, r] 照亮，当且仅当 l≤p 且 r≥p；右端点小于 p 的灯，左端点也一定小于 p。
覆盖数 = 左端点 ≤ p 的灯数 − 右端点 < p 的灯数；把所有左端点、右端点分别排序后，两个数量都能二分得到。
分别排序 l 数组和 r 数组；每个查询 p 计算 upper_bound(l, p) − lower_bound(r, p)，注意一个是“≤”一个是“<”，端点处也算照亮；按查询顺序用空格输出。
en: Position p is lit by [l, r] exactly when l ≤ p and r ≥ p; any lamp whose right end is below p also has its left end below p.
Coverage = (lamps with left end ≤ p) − (lamps with right end < p); after sorting all left ends and all right ends separately, both counts come from binary search.

Sort the l array and the r array separately; for each query p compute upper_bound(l, p) − lower_bound(r, p), noting that one is "≤" and the other "<" because endpoints count as lit; print the answers in query order separated by spaces.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the left endpoints and the right endpoints separately; the number of intervals covering p is the number of left endpoints not greater than p minus the number of right endpoints less than p.

## Correctness

An interval contains p if and only if l ≤ p and r ≥ p. upper_bound(l, p) includes intervals whose left endpoint equals p, and lower_bound(r, p) only excludes intervals with r < p, so the endpoint conditions are right.

## Complexity

Preprocessing O(n log n), each query O(log n), space O(n).
